listing.title: ULTRA DEFENCE HYBRID SUNSCREEN FLUID - SPF 50 50ml
listing.body_text:
Ultra Defence Hybrid Sunscreen Fluid helps protect the skin against the harmful effects of the sun and its UV rays. It has a soft, dry, water-resistant finish. The formulation includes both mineral and chemical filters that are encapsulated for long-lasting protection against the UVA and UVB rays.

Our Ultra Defence SPF 50 Sunscreen has a gel-based lightweight fluid texture that comes with sustainable packaging, airless pump-based tube & is travel-friendly.

Testing Method: In-vitro SPF obtained for Ultra Defence Sun Fluid is 75.36 using COLIPA method
COLIPA Guidelines,
In accordance to Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009
Critical wavelength 378
PA rating as PA++++

*New Look same formulation

WHAT IT IS:

A high-performance Hybrid SPF 50 Sun Fluid featuring Tinosorb S, Uvinul A Plus, and Zinc Oxide for advanced UVA + UVB protection. Engineered with Liposomal Encapsulation Technology, it delivers deep, stable, and even sun protection — offering the best of both mineral and chemical filters in a single, weightless formula.

HOW IT DOES:
This advanced hybrid formula combines chemical and mineral filters in a modern encapsulated system:

Tinosorb S offers broad-spectrum protection and photostability against both UVA and UVB rays.

Uvinul A Plus defends against long UVA rays to prevent pigmentation and premature ageing.

Zinc Oxide soothes, reinforces the barrier, and prevents redness.

Liposomal Encapsulation Technology enhances dispersion, absorption, and wearability — ensuring invisible, long-lasting protection without clogging pores or leaving residue.

Together, these actives deliver next-generation UV protection with a sheer, satin finish that feels weightless on the skin — protecting, perfecting, and preventing sun damage in one step.

WHAT IT DOES:
The Ultra Defence Hybrid Sun Fluid shields skin from UV damage, photoageing, and pigmentation while maintaining a smooth, invisible finish. Tinosorb S and Uvinul A Plus provide high-level, long-lasting UV defense without irritation, while Zinc Oxide reinforces barrier protection and calms redness. The hybrid system ensures sweat resistance, even coverage, and effortless blending — perfect for daily wear under or over skincare.
